identifier.accountNumber.$comment: Sonar exposes no account_number field. The account number IS the account id, so the identifier binds to a different argument per entity.
identifier.accountNumber.title: Sonar account number

identifier.serialNumber.$comment: Not a first-class argument on any Sonar root. Stored as an inventory_model_field_data row, so it resolves through a scoped hop.
identifier.serialNumber.title: ONT / CPE serial number
